[[File:Leather chaps detail.png|left|100px]]
'''Leather chaps''' is a part of [[leather armour]] that is worn in the [[legs slot]], most commonly by low-level [[ranged|rangers]]. Low-levelled player [[mage]]s also often wear these chaps, since they give a slight defence bonuses without a magic attack penalty.
